purpose: Independent retained Windows input/output measurements for Bitmap16 HALFTONE implementation; no renderer-generated expected values or fitted tolerances.
consumer: Bitmap(file,FALSE), GetRawFormat then GetLastStatus; default interpolation PixelOffsetHalf TileFlipXY natural DrawImage; unmodified RGBA; intrinsic/natural compared; no direct GDI captures
pixelPolicy: Exact unmodified measured RGBA inside the original integer device destination rectangle. Pixels are opaque; no matte, color transform, clipping adjustment, kernel regeneration or tolerance applied. Full canvas/ROP/clipping invariants retain separate family controls.
